drivers.title: Binance replenishes 90% of assets stolen in record hack
drivers.detail: Crypto exchange says it has set aside around $6.34-billion of company funds to cover losses (Globe and Mail, Cointelegraph are covering it.)

drivers.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
drivers.detail: While the FBI listed hundreds of addresses in its notice, Chainalysis said the Binance attackers have already used "thousands addresses," and expects this number to continue growing. (CoinDesk.)

drivers.title: Bitcoin's white paper turns 18, and small businesses are still paying for the bailouts it answered
drivers.detail: Eighteen years after Satoshi published the Bitcoin white paper, business owners are still covering the cost of a system built on bailouts, and they can protect part of their surplus by keeping it in bitcoin, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma. (CoinDesk.)

drivers.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem
drivers.detail: Two strangers befriended Magnus Ahmad outside a London bar. Hours later, thieves had emptied his crypto wallets, accessed his bank accounts and disabled his laptop. (CoinDesk.)

drivers.title: Traders are already placing leveraged bets on Anthropic’s IPO using crypto contracts
drivers.detail: Trade.xyz’s new ANT contract fell about 20% in its first hour on Hyperliquid. There are no shares behind it, and U.S. traders are locked out. (CoinDesk.)
